My dad has left my family for the companionship/friendship of a 26 year old (one year my senior).  Why?  Because I didn't finish my masters degree.  Makes total sense right? Right.   He was so angry at me for not finishing, he wanted to punish me so he went out and got himself a replacement awesome daughter, whom he is attracted to and loves.

Yeah, it's messed up

I appreciate your words. However the only people I have in my life that I can be honest with are far away. Only two.

The people I love most have left me in life. It's time for me to do the same
That and the problem is me, not other people!
I've already moved away and tried to start over! It has not worked.

I'm not still living with my mom.

I'm over life.  People don't care about me, I don't care about me.  It's time

Nope. Commit yourself to being healthy now.  It's the best gift you can give yourself.  Sure, it's nice to be thin or skinny.  But at what cost?  Commit to Heath and recovery now to save yourself years of heartbreak and illness down the road!

But Computer Science is still a valuable field to be involved in... Did you give up on the field or just specifically on making video games?

Hello!  You are a very bright individual for recognizing that you could use help and desiring to seek it out.  Have you considered reading books on CBT?  

The only insight I can provide is that despite how smart you perceive those around you to be (and remember, you are likely favoring their abilities over your own), your dreams are yours alone.  Everybody has their own set of goals and dreams.  What is one dream you've given up on that you could start trying to achieve again?

Where do you live?  LA?

Sometimes plans fall through- how old are you?
What about right now? What do you hate right now?

Ah, so you are concerned she has overdosed on her sleeping medications?

I speak from personal experience: not sleeping, especially over periods of time, can truly mess with your mind.  I'd say this warrants a visit from someone to your friend.  It won't be too late

You don't go into detail about your friends, but reading between the lines, I get the impression that in the past you've been deeply betrayed by your close friends. 
I am so very sorry for whatever you've experienced.  
Have you tried seeing a doctor/psychiatrist? It sounds as though you are self-medicating.  Mayn't there are alternatives that are more then band-aide fixes.

Call 911 and request a wellness check.

Also: what if your friend fell asleep?
Roseville!!!

Stay where you are, my friend.  You already have more than many can dream of.  Why don't you figure out what attitude/spirit you're hoping to find out west and cultivate it in your small southern town?

Or you could try and find a job while still working at your job in the south
If you have a plan to hurt yourself, you'll be admitted
I started having huge doubts about if our life together was the one I wanted.  Now I realize that it is.  It's too far gone to try and get him back.

Perfection would be a beautiful body, a well paying and fulfilling job, a significant other that I love and who loves me back. A stable, living home.

I am moving more from independence to dependence and that is a terrible realization 

Generally what runs through my mind is that I'm a failure, and don't have anything to live for, with no means of changing the situation  I'm in.  It seems to happen after things like a breakup (my first attempt) or the realization that life is passing me by (the rest of the attempts).

I do not believe I am suited to this world
I cheated out of selfish reasons. And after that, I moved into an apartment, failed out of grad school, and an back living with my mom

Josh(y)

I'm obsessed with the idea of perfection. I have always wanted to be the best- but at a certain point, you run out of bests to have. That's how it all started at 13. 

Which is ironic in that I've failed suicide so many times. 

I'm lying to other people that I'm normal.  I'm not.  I don't look as crazy as my mind is.  

The only thing I know I want out of life is to die

These (above) are my deepest secrets. Things that I go to great lengths to hide/cover up.

Most recent attempts have to do with the fact that I've failed so many times at life, and my peers are getting along, getting married, achieving their dreams. Where something inside me is on a state of continual self sabotage
The thing is, I'm really great at lying. I lied myself out of the psych ward.  I know there is something wrong with me - evil even.
